f9103fc3: This code is used to update a record in a FileMan file. It checks if the variable DG has a value greater than 9, and if so, it calls the F^DIE17 routine to perform the update. It then sets Y to the ASCII unit delimiter (U) and DQ to 19. If the variable DIEFIRE exists and is not equal to 0, it calls the FIREREC^DIE17 routine. If Y is undefined or equal to U, it branches to the label A. If Y has a value, it stores it in X and sets DIC(0) to F and DW to DQ. Finally, it calls the OUT^DIE17 routine.
